My life: My elder sister is an engineer. She lives in a flat in Germany. Her dream is to see Japan and the world. Everyone in our family is friendly. What is your hobby? Tell us about yourself — your age and your country. German grammar sounds hard, but we can learn.
我姐姐是工程师，住在德国的一套公寓。她的梦想是去看看日本和更广阔的世界。我们家人都很友善。你的爱好是什么？介绍一下你自己——年龄和家乡。德语语法听起来难，但我们能学。

I live with my family in a small flat. In the morning I pack my school bag and say hello to my neighbours. After class I finish homework first, then I play with friends. At night I read a short story and write three new words. This is my life — simple plans, kind people, and a little English every day.
我和家人住在一套小公寓。早上我收拾书包，跟邻居问好。放学后我先写作业，再和朋友玩。晚上读一篇短故事，写下三个新词。这就是我的生活——简单计划、友善的人，以及每天一点英语。
The natural world: The natural world is full of small surprises. Birds sing near the river. Trees give cool cover on hot days. If we keep parks clean, animals can find food and quiet places. Look carefully: a leaf, a cloud, a fish in clear water — each one tells a short story. Protect nature with small acts: pick up rubbish, save water, plant one tree.
自然世界充满小惊喜。鸟在河边歌唱。大树在热天送来阴凉。如果我们保持公园干净，动物就能找到食物和安静的地方。仔细看：一片叶子、一朵云、清水里的鱼——每一件都在讲短故事。用小事保护自然：捡垃圾、节水、种一棵树。

Mountains, rivers, and forests work together. Rain falls, plants grow, and animals find homes. When one part changes, other parts feel it. In science class we draw a simple food chain and talk about why green plants matter. Walk outside this week and write five things you see in nature.
山、河、森林彼此协作。雨水落下，植物生长，动物找到家。一部分一变，其它部分也会感受到。科学课上我们画简单的食物链，讨论绿植为何重要。这周走到户外，写下你在自然中看到的五样东西。
Travels: Travel starts with a map and a clear plan. Pack light: water, a ticket, and a notebook. Ask politely when you are lost. Try local food and thank the people who help you. Photos are nice, but short notes help you remember the trip better. Safe travel means check the weather and stay with your group.
旅行从地图和清楚的计划开始。轻装：水、票、笔记本。迷路时礼貌地问路。试试当地食物，感谢帮你的人。照片很好，但短笔记更能帮你记住旅程。安全旅行要看天气、跟紧队伍。

A short trip can teach more than a long holiday. Visit a museum, a park, or a small town near home. Talk to local people in simple English if you can. Compare what you expected with what you really saw. Come home and share three facts with your class.
短途旅行可能比漫长假期学到更多。去博物馆、公园或家附近的小镇。若可以，用简单英语和当地人说话。对比你的期待和真实所见。回家后跟同学分享三个事实。
Fun time: Fun time is not wasted time. Play a game, sing a song, or draw a picture after hard work. Choose activities that make you smile and also wake your mind. Share fun with friends, but keep rules fair for everyone. Rest well so tomorrow you can learn with energy.
娱乐时间不是浪费。辛苦学习后玩游戏、唱歌或画画。选让你微笑又能唤醒大脑的活动。和朋友一起玩，但规则要对人人公平。休息好，明天才能有精力学习。

Clubs after school can be fun and useful. You may join music, sports, or a reading group. Practice a little every week and you will improve. If you lose a match, learn one skill and try again. Fun grows when you help a new member feel welcome.
课后社团既好玩又有用。你可以参加音乐、运动或阅读小组。每周练一点就会进步。若比赛输了，学一项技能再试。帮助新成员感到受欢迎时，乐趣会增长。
People and places: People and places shape each other. A busy market feels loud and bright. A library feels quiet and safe. Ask who works there and what they care about. Draw a simple map of your street and mark three helpful places. Kind words make any place nicer.
人与地方彼此塑造。热闹的市场又吵又亮；图书馆安静又安全。问问谁在那里工作、他们在意什么。画一张你家街道的简图，标出三个有用的地方。友善的话让任何地方都更美好。

When you visit a new place, watch how people greet each other. Some shake hands; some smile and say hello. Learn one local custom and follow it carefully. Write a short diary: who you met, where you went, what surprised you. Places become real when you remember the people.
到新地方时，观察人们如何打招呼。有人握手，有人微笑问好。学一项当地习俗并认真遵守。写短日记：见了谁、去了哪、什么让你惊讶。当你记住那里的人，地方才变得真实。
Man’s best friends: Dogs and cats can be our best friends. They need food, water, clean space, and kind hands. Train a pet with care, not anger. If you cannot keep an animal, help at an animal home or feed birds in winter. Friendship with animals teaches care for others.
猫狗可以是我们最好的朋友。它们需要食物、水、干净空间和温柔的手。用关心而非愤怒训练宠物。若不能养宠物，去动物之家帮忙或在冬天喂鸟。与动物的友谊教我们关爱他人。

A guide dog helps people walk safely. Farm dogs watch the land. Cats keep quiet friends at home. Before you get a pet, ask: do we have time every day? Read about animal needs in a short book or a class text. Love means work, not only cute photos.
导盲犬帮助人们安全行走。农场犬守着土地。猫在家里安静陪伴。养宠物前先问：我们每天有时间吗？读一本短书或课文了解动物需求。爱意味着付出，而不只是可爱照片。
Natural elements: Water, air, earth, and fire are basic parts of nature. We drink water, take in air, and grow food from the ground. Fire can cook and heat us, but it is also dangerous. In experiments, change one thing at a time and write what happens. Care for nature: save water, keep air clean, protect the ground.
水、空气、泥土与火是自然的基本部分。我们喝水、吸入空气、从土地种出食物。火能做饭取暖，但也危险。实验时一次只改一样，并写下结果。关爱自然：节水、保持空气清洁、保护土地。

Weather shows nature at work. Wind moves clouds. Sun heats the land. Rain fills rivers. Keep a seven-day weather diary with simple words: sunny, rainy, windy, cold. Compare your notes with a classmate. Science begins when you notice patterns.
天气展现自然如何运作。风推动云，阳光加热大地，雨水注满河流。用简单词做七天天气日记：晴、雨、风、冷。和同学对比笔记。当你发现规律，科学就开始了。
Colourful life: A colourful life mixes study, rest, and hobbies. Try art, music, or sport on different days. Do not fill every hour; leave space to think. Help at home and talk with family about your day. Colour comes from a calm week plan, not from rushing all the time.
多彩生活把学习、休息和爱好混在一起。不同日子试试艺术、音乐或运动。别把每一小时都填满，留点空间思考。在家帮忙，并和家人聊聊今天。色彩来自平静的一周计划，而不是一直赶路。

Festivals make life colourful. Prepare a small gift, learn a song, or cook a simple dish. Invite a friend to join and explain the meaning in English. After the festival, write what you liked and what you would change next year. Memory grows when you take part, not only watch.
节日让生活多彩。准备小礼物、学首歌，或做一道简单菜。邀请朋友一起，用英语解释含义。节日后写下你喜欢什么、明年想改什么。参与其中记忆才生长，而不是只旁观。
Amazing things: Amazing things are often small at first. A seed becomes a tree. A short practice becomes a skill. Ask how and why, then test your idea safely. Keep a wonder list in your notebook: three amazing facts each week. Share one fact with the class in clear English.
惊人的事起初往往很小。种子长成树。短暂练习变成技能。问如何与为何，再安全地验证想法。在笔记本里列惊奇清单：每周三个惊人事实。用清楚的英语和全班分享一个事实。

Museums show amazing tools, old maps, and special objects. Read the signs slowly. Choose one object and explain why it changed people’s lives. Draw it and write five English words about it. Wonder is a habit: look twice before you walk past.
博物馆展示惊人的工具、古地图和特别物品。慢慢读说明。选一件物品，解释它如何改变人们的生活。画下来并写五个相关英语词。惊奇是一种习惯：走过之前再看一眼。
Science and technology: Science and technology help us solve problems, but they need careful people. Check facts before you believe a message online. In lab work, follow safety rules and write clear results. A good invention saves time or protects people — say which one you care about most.
科技帮我们解决问题，但需要谨慎的人。网上信息先核实再相信。实验课遵守安全规则，写清结果。好发明能省时间或保护人——说说你最在意哪一种。

Phones and computers are tools, not teachers. Use them to look up a word, then close the screen and practice. Build a small project: a poster, a model, or a short talk about one invention. Team work matters: one plans, one builds, one checks. Technology serves learning when you stay in control.
手机和电脑是工具，不是老师。用它们查一个词，然后关掉屏幕去练习。做一个小项目：海报、模型，或关于一项发明的短演讲。团队合作重要：一人计划、一人制作、一人检查。当你掌控节奏，科技才服务学习。
Culture and history: Culture and history live in stories, festivals, and old buildings. Visit a local museum if you can. Ask elders about life when they were young. Compare one custom from China with one from another country in simple English. Care grows when we learn before we decide.
文化与历史活在故事、节日和老建筑里。若可以，参观本地博物馆。问问长辈他们年轻时的生活。用简单英语比较中国与另一个国家的一项习俗。先了解再决定，关心才会生长。

History is not only dates. It is choices people made in hard times. Read a short life story and note two decisions the person faced. Draw a time line with five key events in your own words. Remember: every city has many voices — listen for more than one.
历史不只是日期，而是人们在艰难时刻做的选择。读一篇短短的人生故事，记下那人面对的两个决定。用自己的话画五件大事的时间线。记住：每座城市都有许多声音——多听几种。
School life: School life is more than tests. Greet teachers, help classmates, and keep your desk tidy. When a lesson is hard, ask one clear question. Join one club and practice for ten minutes a day. A calm morning plan makes the whole day easier.
学校生活不只是考试。向老师问好，帮助同学，保持课桌整齐。课很难时，问一个清楚的问题。加入一个社团，每天练十分钟。平静的早晨计划会让整天更轻松。

Group projects teach school life skills. Divide jobs fairly and finish on time. Listen before you disagree. Write a short report the whole group can explain. If someone is quiet, invite them to share one idea. Success is the team’s work, not one star alone.
小组项目教学校生活技能。公平分工并按时完成。不同意之前先听。写一份全组都能讲解的短报告。若有人沉默，邀请他分享一个想法。成功是团队的工作，不是一颗明星独自完成。
Social communication: Social communication starts with listening. Look at the speaker and wait your turn. Use polite phrases: please, thank you, sorry, excuse me. Online messages need care too — never send words you would not say face to face. Clear talk prevents many problems.
社交沟通从倾听开始。看着说话的人，轮到你再开口。使用礼貌用语：请、谢谢、对不起、借过。网上留言也要谨慎——别发你当面不会说的话。清楚表达能避免很多问题。
When friends disagree, stay calm. Say what you feel without hard words. Offer a plan and ask what they need. If you make a mistake, say sorry early. Strong friendships grow from honest and kind talk.
朋友意见不合时保持冷静。说出感受，不要用伤人的话。提出一个计划，并问对方需要什么。若你错了，尽早说对不起。牢固的友谊来自诚实又友善的交流。
Arts and crafts: Art and hand work train careful hands and quiet minds. Choose paper, soft material, or clay and plan your picture. Follow steps, then add your own idea. Clean tools and share materials with classmates. A gift you make by hand can say more than expensive things.
美术与手工训练细心的手和安静的心。选择纸、软材料或黏土，先规划画面。按步骤做，再加入你自己的想法。清理工具，与同学分享材料。亲手做的礼物往往比昂贵的东西更能表达心意。

Visit an art show or watch a hand-work video, then try a small copy at home. Write five English words for colours, shapes, and tools you used. Show your work and explain one hard step you solved. Practice turns mistakes into skill.
参观艺术展或看手工视频，然后在家试做一个小作品。写下五个英语词：你用到的颜色、形状和工具。展示作品并解释你解决的一个难点。练习把错误变成技能。
Animals: Wild animals need space, food, and quiet. Do not feed them human food. Learn which animals live near your city and how to watch them safely. Zoos can teach, but wild homes matter more. Protect animals by protecting forests, rivers, and clean air.
野生动物需要空间、食物和安静。不要用人吃的食物喂它们。了解你家附近有哪些动物，以及如何安全观察。动物园能教学，但野生长家更重要。保护动物就是保护森林、河流和清洁的空气。

Some animals help farmers; some keep nature in good order. Read one short article about an animal in danger and note two causes. Tell your class what people can do this month. Care for animals is care for our shared world.
有些动物帮助农民，有些让自然保持良好秩序。读一篇关于濒危动物的短文，记下两个原因。告诉全班这个月人们能做什么。关爱动物就是关爱我们共同的世界。
Discovery: Discovery begins with a question you really want to answer. Write the question down. Collect facts from books, safe websites, and teachers. Test one idea and record what changes. Share your discovery in five clear sentences.
发现始于一个你真正想回答的问题。先把问题写下来。从书本、安全网站和老师那里收集事实。验证一个想法并记录变化。用五句清楚的话分享你的发现。

People discover places; scientists discover rules. You can discover too in daily life. Notice how plants grow to the light. Notice how ice turns to water faster in hot water. Keep a discovery notebook with date, method, and result. Asking questions is a skill you can practice.
人们发现地方；科学家发现规律。你也能在日常生活中发现。注意植物如何朝光生长。注意冰在热水中如何更快变成水。用日期、方法和结果做发现笔记。提问是可以练习的技能。
Geniuses: Very clever people work hard for a long time. Talent helps, but practice builds real skill. Read about one scientist or artist and list three habits they kept. Copy one habit for a week: early start, careful notes, or daily review. Great work is often quiet work repeated.
很聪明的人也会长期努力。天赋有用，但练习造就真本领。读一位科学家或艺术家的故事，列出他们坚持的三个习惯。一周模仿一个习惯：早起、细心笔记或每日复习。伟大的工作常常是安静的重复。

Not every clever student looks famous at school. Some learn slowly, then jump ahead. Ask for help early. Teach a friend what you just learned. Keep trying after small mistakes. Your best idea may come after many common days.
并非每位聪明学生在学校都显眼。有人学得慢，然后突然跃进。尽早求助。把刚学会的教给朋友。小错误后继续试。你最好的想法可能出现在许多平常日子之后。
Ideas and viewpoints: Ideas can differ and still be useful. Listen first, then explain your reason. Use facts, examples, and clear words. Change your mind when new facts appear — that shows real power, not weakness. Write both sides of a topic before you choose.
想法可以不同却仍有用。先听，再说明理由。使用事实、例子和清楚的词语。有新事实时改变想法——那显示真正的力量，不是软弱。选题前先写下正反两面。

In class talks, attack the idea, not the person. Keep time fair for each speaker. Take notes on strong points from the other side. End with one sentence you both agree on. Good discussion builds better thinking for everyone.
课堂讨论中，反驳观点而非攻击人。给每位发言者公平时间。记下对方的有力论点。最后写一句双方都同意的话。好的讨论让每个人的思维更好。
Leisure time: Free time rests your mind. Read for pleasure, walk outside, or play a quiet game. Stop screens before sleep so you rest well. Plan free time like you plan study: short, regular, and enjoyable. Balanced days make stronger learners.
空闲时间让大脑休息。为乐趣阅读、到户外走走，或玩安静的游戏。睡前停下屏幕，才能休息好。像安排学习一样安排空闲：短、规律、愉快。平衡的日子造就更强的学习者。

Hobby clubs turn free time into skill. Photos, chess, dance, or planting all teach careful work. Set a small goal for this month and show your progress. Invite a classmate who feels lonely to join once. Free time is richer when shared kindly.
爱好社团把空闲变成技能。摄影、象棋、舞蹈或种植都教细心工作。为本月设一个小目标并展示进步。邀请一位感到孤单的同学参加一次。善意分享时，空闲更丰富。
A taste of literature: Stories let you live many lives in one book. Read a short story slowly and mark new feelings. Ask: who wants what, and what stands in the way? Write five sentences that retell the ending in your own words. Good readers notice both the story and the heart.
故事让你在一本书里过许多人生。慢慢读短篇，标出新的感受。问：谁想要什么，什么挡住了路？用五句话按自己的话复述结局。好的读者既看见故事，也看见人心。

Poems play with sound and picture. Read one poem aloud twice. Circle three strong words and explain why they matter. Try writing four lines about rain, friendship, or home. Stories and poems grow when you answer them with your own voice.
诗歌玩弄声音与画面。把一首诗大声读两遍。圈出三个有力的词并解释为何重要。试写四行关于雨、友谊或家的诗。当你用自己的声音回应，故事和诗才会生长。
Explorations and exchanges: Explorations and exchanges connect people across places. Students may visit another school or write to a pen friend. Prepare questions and listen more than you speak. Share food, songs, or school rules with care. Exchange means both sides learn.
探索与交流把不同地方的人连起来。学生可能访问另一所学校或给笔友写信。准备问题，多听少说。小心地分享食物、歌曲或校规。交流意味着双方都学习。

Online exchanges need safety rules. Never share your home address or secret numbers. Use school email when your teacher asks. After a talk, write three new facts you learned about the other culture. Real friendship grows from care and honesty.
线上交流需要安全规则。绝不分享家庭住址或秘密号码。老师要求时使用学校邮箱。交流后写下你学到的关于另一种文化的三个新事实。真正的友谊来自关心与诚实。
Environmental problems: Environmental problems touch air, water, and waste. Start at home: put rubbish in the right bins and turn off lights you do not use. At school, join a clean-up or a tree-planting day. Talk about one local problem and one possible fix. Small habits, kept by many people, change a city.
环境问题关系到空气、水与垃圾。从家里开始：把垃圾放进正确的桶，关掉不用的灯。在学校参加清洁日或植树。讨论一个本地问题和一个可能的办法。许多人坚持的小习惯，会改变一座城市。

Plastic in rivers hurts fish and birds. Carry a reusable bottle and bag. Write a short poster with three green ideas in English. Ask your family to try one idea for a week. Protecting the earth is daily work, not only a big word on a wall.
河里的塑料伤害鱼和鸟。带可重复使用的瓶子和袋子。用英语写一张写着三条绿色想法的短海报。请家人一周试行一条。保护地球是日常工作，而不只是墙上的大话。
Sport and health: Sport and health go together. Prepare your body before you run. Drink water and rest when you feel tired. Team sports teach fair play: follow rules and cheer for others. Sleep enough — strong bodies need quiet nights. Healthy habits beat short food plans that never last.
运动与健康相伴。跑步前先活动身体。感觉累时喝水休息。团队运动教公平竞赛：遵守规则并为他人加油。睡够——强壮的身体需要安静的夜晚。健康习惯胜过无法长久的短期饮食计划。

You do not need to be a star to enjoy sport. Walk, move, or play ball with friends. Keep a weekly record: minutes of exercise and how you feel. If you are hurt, tell a teacher and stop. Health is progress you can check in energy, not only in scores.
你不必成为明星也能享受运动。散步、活动身体，或和朋友打球。做每周记录：运动分钟数和你的感觉。若受伤，告诉老师并停下。健康是你可以在精力里检查的进步，而不只是分数。
